catalogMeta.title: Thrivefold Real Game Content Catalog
catalogMeta.principle: Static JSON defines authored tasks and rules; dynamic engine selects assignments; evidence determines verification; backend determines permanent rewards.
catalogMeta.importantLimit: This file is a substantial authored starting catalog, not proof of clinical validation, app integration, or backend deployment. Health content marked for review must be reviewed before release.

ethicalBoundaries.purpose: Support self-directed wellbeing, health literacy, and personal development without judging a person's worth or sensitive identity.
consentRules: Sensitive fields are optional and collected only when a feature has a clear purpose.
Users can skip, edit, disable, or delete optional profile context where legally applicable.
No points or level requirements depend on disclosing religion, sex, sexual history, reproductive status, body measurements, or mental-health details.
Face images, biometric templates, and facial-landmark measurements are not collected by this catalog.
Do not display private health or faith data in public profiles, social feeds, or notifications without separate explicit consent.
verificationHonesty: System-verified means the app can validate the specified digital event, not necessarily an external real-world fact.
Self-reported activity must remain labelled self-reported.
A clinician result manually entered by the user is not independently authenticated unless an actual authorized integration confirms provenance.
No client-side button, local counter, or AI response can independently grant authoritative permanent rewards.

sections.title: Choose what matters
sections.content: A useful goal is defined by the player and linked to a concrete next action.

sections.title: Make the first step small
sections.content: Choose an action that is feasible in current circumstances rather than relying on perfect motivation.

sections.title: Plan for interruptions
sections.content: A flexible backup, pause, or revised goal is a valid response to changing circumstances.

sections.title: What completion proves
sections.content: An app can verify recorded steps; it cannot establish every external event or a person's worth.

sections.title: Compare like with like
sections.content: Check serving size and use the same basis when comparing labels.

sections.title: Consider the whole pattern
sections.content: Food choices should account for variety, adequacy, preference, local availability, and health needs.

sections.title: Respect chosen constraints
sections.content: User-selected restrictions, allergies, and cultural or faith-related food choices must be respected without inferring identity.

sections.title: What BMI is
sections.content: BMI relates body weight to height and is used as a screening measure.

sections.title: What BMI does not measure directly
sections.content: BMI does not directly measure body-fat percentage or distinguish fat, muscle, and bone mass.

sections.title: Use context
sections.content: An individual's interpretation may require other health measures and professional assessment.

sections.title: Clinical measurement
sections.content: Bone mineral density can be measured by tests such as DXA/DEXA when clinically appropriate.

sections.title: Appearance is not a test
sections.content: A person's appearance, face shape, height, or game score cannot establish bone density.

sections.title: Review results in context
sections.content: A qualified healthcare professional interprets results alongside history and other risk factors.

sections.title: Consistent routine
sections.content: Authoritative oral-health guidance commonly recommends regular brushing with fluoride toothpaste and cleaning between teeth; individualized dental instructions may differ.

sections.title: Professional care
sections.content: Dental professionals can assess conditions that an app or photograph cannot reliably diagnose.

sections.title: Personalized advice
sections.content: Follow advice from your dental professional for your circumstances.

sections.title: Privacy and choice
sections.content: This optional lesson does not require disclosure of sexual history or orientation.

sections.title: General education
sections.content: The final published lesson must use qualified, reviewed, current sexual-health information appropriate to the user's jurisdiction and age.

sections.title: When to seek care
sections.content: A quiz cannot replace personalized care from a qualified professional.

sections.title: Communicate clearly
sections.content: Use clear communication and respect each person's boundaries.

sections.title: Choice can change
sections.content: A person can pause or withdraw agreement; do not pressure them.

sections.title: No forced disclosure
sections.content: The app never needs to collect a player's sexual history to teach consent.

lessonDefinitions.title: Know Where a Health Record Came From

sections.title: Source matters
sections.content: Distinguish self-entered values, connected-device events, and clinical records.

sections.title: Date and method matter
sections.content: Store a timestamp, units, and measurement method where applicable.

sections.title: Do not overclaim
sections.content: A correctly stored record does not automatically establish a diagnosis.

sections.title: Check the source
sections.content: Look at who made a claim, the evidence offered, its date, and relevant conflicts of interest.

sections.title: Represent uncertainty
sections.content: When evidence is limited, say so instead of turning a guess into a fact.

sections.title: Personal stories have limits
sections.content: Anecdotes can be meaningful but do not prove that a result will apply to everyone.

lessonDefinitions.title: What Body Measurements Can Tell You

sections.title: Record the real source
sections.content: Keep measurement units, date, and source together.

sections.title: No appearance-based estimates
sections.content: Do not infer body-fat percentage or bone density from a photograph, face, or body shape.

sections.title: No body worth score
sections.content: Measurements are optional records, not scores of beauty, morality, or personal worth.

derivedMeasurementDefinitions.name: BMI screening calculation
derivedMeasurementDefinitions.ageRule: Use adult screening interpretation only where applicable for age 20 and older; do not apply adult categories to children or teens.
limitations: BMI is not direct body-fat measurement.
BMI does not distinguish fat, muscle, and bone mass.
Do not infer fat distribution from BMI.
Do not use as diagnosis, beauty score, worth score, task reward, or automatic diet prescription.

derivedMeasurementDefinitions.name: Body-composition entry gate
derivedMeasurementDefinitions.rule: Accept only explicitly entered or actually integrated measurements; leave unknown values null rather than estimating them from photos, height, weight, or face shape.

derivedMeasurementDefinitions.name: Recorded body-fat result
derivedMeasurementDefinitions.rule: No estimate is produced unless a separately validated device integration explicitly supplies it. No photograph-based estimate.

derivedMeasurementDefinitions.name: Recorded bone-density result
derivedMeasurementDefinitions.rule: The app stores the result; clinical interpretation remains with an appropriate healthcare professional.

pointEconomy.targetSnapshot: Persist the selected target, local game date, time-zone ID, policy version, and assignment set; do not raise the target retroactively after the player earns points.
pointEconomy.dailyRollover: Use the player's stored IANA time-zone identifier. Reconcile late offline events to their recorded game date using trusted timestamps and defined offline policy; do not trust an arbitrary client total.
pointEconomy.example: If the target is 40 and eligible completions sum to 25, accepting a special quest changes nothing. A verified 15-point quest makes progress 40/40. A 10-point quest makes it 35/40. Skipping never increases progress.

No reward from a skip, reroll, acceptance, start, abandonment, or duplicate submission.
Once accepted, the task identity, evidence policy, and reward snapshot remain stable.

Do not impose arbitrary punitive skip limits; block farming through assignment identity, eligibility, recurrence, fresh evidence, and idempotency.

dailyTaskRules.assignmentSource: taskDefinitions and specialQuestDefinitions in this catalog
dailyTaskRules.assignmentSelection: Deterministic eligibility filter first, then player-goal and task-selection ranking; save the resulting assignment snapshot.
rules: Do not assign tasks whose eligibility, safety, prerequisite, or optional-feature constraints fail.
Never use gender alone to select reproductive or anatomy-specific tasks.
Do not force body measurement, food tracking, mental-health disclosure, faith disclosure, or sexual-health education.
Avoid assigning the same task repeatedly without a valid recurrence rule and fresh evidence.
Keep the same daily assignment after refresh and app restart.
The player may skip today and choose an eligible special quest.
The daily target snapshot remains stable for the game date unless the player explicitly changes a permitted plan setting; a change cannot erase or fabricate existing points.
dailyTaskRules.dailyContributionFormula: Sum accepted, eligible point ledger contributions for the player's game date and target policy. UI progress is min(sum, target); ledger retains underlying legitimate contributions.
dailyTaskRules.pendingEvidence: Pending, rejected, skipped, or unverified claims do not contribute authoritative points unless the task's explicit self-report policy permits provisional display; provisional values must be labelled and reconciled.
dailyTaskRules.selectionSeed: Persist deterministic selection seed and catalog/ruleset versions for reproducibility. Do not reroll on screen refresh.

specialQuestDefinitions.title: Daily Reset
specialQuestDefinitions.purpose: Replace an unsuitable daily assignment with a short, constructive planning activity.
specialQuestDefinitions.description: Use when today's default task does not fit. Complete the plan; skipping alone earns nothing.
specialQuestDefinitions.safety: Never mandatory; no penalty for not choosing a replacement.

specialQuestDefinitions.title: Learning Sprint
specialQuestDefinitions.purpose: Make measurable progress in an authored lesson and assessment.
specialQuestDefinitions.description: Complete a real lesson and pass its registered knowledge check.
specialQuestDefinitions.safety: Must not issue rewards unless lesson and assessment are both accepted.

specialQuestDefinitions.title: Routine Tune-up
specialQuestDefinitions.purpose: Improve the plan for one routine using a concrete barrier and backup.
specialQuestDefinitions.description: Review a habit, identify a barrier, and save a practical backup plan.
specialQuestDefinitions.safety: Plan may explicitly include reducing demands or resting.

specialQuestDefinitions.title: Food That Fits You
specialQuestDefinitions.purpose: Build a practical food plan that honors chosen preferences and access.
specialQuestDefinitions.description: Review preferences and create one compatible meal or grocery plan.
specialQuestDefinitions.safety: Respect allergies, restrictions, budget, culture, faith, and local food access; never infer religion.

specialQuestDefinitions.title: Recovery Reset
specialQuestDefinitions.purpose: Select an activity, lighter option, or rest based on current circumstances.
specialQuestDefinitions.description: Make a deliberate recovery plan without needing to prove productivity.
specialQuestDefinitions.safety: Rest is valid; no exercise is required.

specialQuestDefinitions.title: Health Record Detective

chapterDefinitions.primaryOutcome: Maintain sustainable personal-care practices.

chapterDefinitions.description: Practice reflection and optional grounding without turning feelings into diagnoses.
chapterDefinitions.primaryOutcome: Use chosen reflection and coping tools appropriately.

chapterDefinitions.title: Focus & Learning
chapterDefinitions.description: Practice learning, assessment, creative work, and decision-making.
chapterDefinitions.primaryOutcome: Demonstrate understanding and apply it to a meaningful next step.

chapterDefinitions.title: Connection & Boundaries
chapterDefinitions.description: Set boundaries and choose connection or quiet according to your needs.
chapterDefinitions.primaryOutcome: Build communication and relationship skills.

chapterDefinitions.title: Values & Culture
chapterDefinitions.description: Honor self-chosen values and cultural preferences without ranking identity.
chapterDefinitions.primaryOutcome: Align daily choices with values the player chooses to share.

chapterDefinitions.title: Planning & Time
chapterDefinitions.description: Review commitments, make plans, and adjust them when reality changes.
chapterDefinitions.primaryOutcome: Plan with flexibility and realistic expectations.

chapterDefinitions.title: Body Respect & Self-Care
chapterDefinitions.description: Track optional measurements and care preferences without rating attractiveness or worth.
chapterDefinitions.primaryOutcome: Support body agency and interpretation of measurements.

chapterDefinitions.title: Preventive Care & Records
chapterDefinitions.description: Prepare for appointments and maintain records the user chooses to keep.
chapterDefinitions.primaryOutcome: Improve readiness for appropriate professional care.

chapterDefinitions.description: Adapt goals to energy, access, disability, and changing circumstances.
chapterDefinitions.primaryOutcome: Keep progress possible without requiring one specific body or lifestyle.

chapterDefinitions.description: Bring together selected skills into a coherent personal plan.
chapterDefinitions.primaryOutcome: Combine chosen areas of growth without forcing irrelevant health modules.

chapterDefinitions.title: Independent Coaching
chapterDefinitions.description: Review the evidence behind progress and choose the next useful action.
chapterDefinitions.primaryOutcome: Use the engine as a coach rather than depending on prompts or streaks.

chapterDefinitions.description: Maintain a sustainable, self-authored development plan with real milestones.
chapterDefinitions.primaryOutcome: Create a realistic continuing plan and understand its limitations.

levelStageDefinitions.purpose: Understand the chapter's purpose and choose a personally relevant starting point.
levelStageDefinitions.rule: Earn XP from valid tasks; orientation does not create automatic completion.

levelStageDefinitions.purpose: Practice the basics with explicit instructions and realistic alternatives.
levelStageDefinitions.rule: Only eligible task awards contribute XP.

levelStageDefinitions.purpose: Apply a learned skill in a suitable real context and reflect on evidence.
levelStageDefinitions.rule: Existing completions cannot be replayed for duplicate rewards.

levelStageDefinitions.purpose: Plan and execute a chosen action with less scaffolding where suitable.
levelStageDefinitions.rule: Evidence and task eligibility remain mandatory.

levelStageDefinitions.purpose: Adjust an approach based on experience, constraints, or new information.
levelStageDefinitions.rule: Changing or pausing a goal may be a valid outcome.

levelStageDefinitions.purpose: Review chapter evidence and prepare for a meaningful checkpoint.
levelStageDefinitions.rule: No repetition-only requirement; use valid task evidence and reflection.

levelStageDefinitions.purpose: Complete a real chapter checkpoint selected from eligible alternatives.
levelStageDefinitions.rule: The chapter checkpoint must be accepted; no sensitive task is mandatory.

levelStageDefinitions.purpose: Demonstrate long-term self-coaching, evidence literacy, and a sustainable continuation plan.
levelStageDefinitions.rule: Requires actual progression and an explicit final review; it is not a decorative badge.

levelProgressionRules.levelSemantics: A level is earned game progression, not a task and not a claim of health status, beauty, morality, or personal worth.
levelProgressionRules.xpRequiredToAdvance: Explicitly stored on each level record; computed once when the static catalog is authored and then validated. Runtime does not invent level content.
levelProgressionRules.chapterMilestones: Every 50 levels has a real chapter checkpoint linked to authored content. The player can select eligible alternatives when a task is irrelevant or inaccessible.
noRepetitionInflation: No task is created merely by changing an integer in its name.
The level manifest is separate from the task catalog.
Previously awarded completion IDs do not award XP again.
Repeated practice grants rewards only when the task's recurrence policy permits fresh evidence.
Sensitive or demographic disclosures are never required to advance general levels.
levelProgressionRules.finalLevel: Level 1000 requires real accumulated XP and final sustainable mastery review. Do not display completion if the final requirements are not met.

selectionSteps: Filter inactive or unreviewed production content.
Filter eligibility, age gates, user consent, prerequisite, recurrence, and safety constraints.
Exclude already-completed non-repeatable tasks and tasks that would duplicate active assignments.
Rank remaining tasks by the player's explicitly selected goals, relevant verified skill outcomes, time, accessibility, and prior task feedback.
Offer a stable eligible task list with reasons.
Persist assignment, catalog version, policy version, selection seed, and rationale codes.
If a task is skipped, offer a distinct eligible special quest or alternative task.
Use deterministic rules when AI or network is unavailable.
coachingRules.aiBoundary: AI may explain authored content or summarize actual saved events; it cannot create production tasks, determine verification outcomes, set points, or override eligibility.

clientProjectionMayContain: non-secret rules required for offline display
clientProjectionRules.requirement: Build a sanitized client projection that strips serverOnlyAssessmentKeys; server verifies quizzes and permanent rewards. Do not import the complete source catalog into the mobile/web client bundle.

rules: Use durable local storage and transactional writes where supported.
Store evidence provenance, catalog/policy versions, assignment IDs, and stable operation IDs.
Offline records may remain locally recorded or pending; do not mislabel them server-confirmed.
Backend validates ownership, current state, policy, prerequisites, reward eligibility, and idempotency.
Duplicate and concurrent requests must not duplicate permanent rewards.
Local counters are projections, never the permanent authority.
Rejected records remain inspectable with an explanation and are not silently erased.
Sensitive measurements, faith preferences, and sexual/reproductive context remain private and access-controlled.

instructions.text: Identify one app or situation you want to change, if any.
Choose a specific boundary or leave settings unchanged if no change is wanted.
Define a realistic exception or fallback.
Save the plan.

safetyConstraints: Do not punish skipped tasks or rest days.
Do not grant points for opening a screen alone.
prohibitedUses: No moral worth score.
No inference of sensitive identity or health conditions.
No public ranking of sensitive information.

taskDefinitions.title: Check that meal suggestions still fit your values
taskDefinitions.shortDescription: Confirm that recommendations respect the preferences the user chose, including but not requiring cultural or faith-related constraints.
taskDefinitions.purpose: Confirm that recommendations respect the preferences the user chose, including but not requiring cultural or faith-related constraints.

instructions.text: Review a sample recommendation generated from saved preferences.
Mark any mismatch.
Correct the relevant preference without entering a religion label.
Save the updated profile if changed.

safetyConstraints: Do not punish skipped tasks or rest days.
Do not grant points for opening a screen alone.
prohibitedUses: No moral worth score.
No inference of sensitive identity or health conditions.
No public ranking of sensitive information.

taskDefinitions.title: Plan a comfortable screen break
taskDefinitions.shortDescription: Choose a practical screen break or display adjustment that supports comfort without claiming to diagnose eye strain.
taskDefinitions.purpose: Choose a practical screen break or display adjustment that supports comfort without claiming to diagnose eye strain.

instructions.text: Notice whether screen work feels uncomfortable or tiring.
Choose one accessible adjustment such as a short break, text-size change, lighting adjustment, or looking away from the screen.
Use the adjustment if it suits you.
Save the plan or skip if it is not relevant.

safetyConstraints: This is not an eye examination or vision diagnosis.
New, severe, or persistent visual symptoms require appropriate professional assessment.
prohibitedUses: No moral worth score.
No inference of sensitive identity or health conditions.
No public ranking of sensitive information.

taskDefinitions.title: Plan how to protect your hearing in a noisy setting
taskDefinitions.shortDescription: Identify a practical hearing-protection action for a situation the user chooses.
taskDefinitions.purpose: Identify a practical hearing-protection action for a situation the user chooses.

instructions.text: Choose a noisy environment you may encounter.
Identify a practical protection option, such as moving away from the source, reducing exposure, or using suitable hearing protection.
Record one early sign that you should step away or seek advice.
Save the plan.

safetyConstraints: No hearing-loss diagnosis.
Do not require the user to expose themselves to loud sound to complete the task.
prohibitedUses: No moral worth score.
No inference of sensitive identity or health conditions.
No public ranking of sensitive information.

taskDefinitions.title: Record a function or discomfort note if useful
taskDefinitions.shortDescription: Allow an optional private record of pain or functional limitation without diagnosing the cause or rewarding disclosure.
taskDefinitions.purpose: Allow an optional private record of pain or functional limitation without diagnosing the cause or rewarding disclosure.

instructions.text: Continue only if you want to record a symptom or functional change.
Describe the location or activity impact in your own words.
Optionally record when it began and what makes it better or worse.
Save privately or exit without penalty.

points.reason: Private tracking or preference configuration must not be incentivized.

safetyConstraints: This record is not a diagnosis.
Do not award points for disclosing pain or health information.
Use separately reviewed safety guidance for urgent symptoms.
prohibitedUses: Do not infer a diagnosis.
Do not expose the record publicly.
Do not reward sensitive health disclosure.
taskDefinitions.pointsPolicyNote: No task points, XP, or skill XP are awarded for recording sensitive measurements, symptoms, faith preferences, or personal tracking settings.
